description: React component for managing requests, including viewing, editing status, assigning mechanics, and closing requests. Contains UI elements, state management, data fetching, and update functions.

methods.name: statusPill
methods.description: Returns a styled span element representing the status label with color coding.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches requests and users data, initializes state for requests, users, and editor states.

methods.name: saveRow
methods.description: Saves updates to a request's status and assigned mechanic.

methods.name: QuickReassign
methods.description: Component for quick reassigning requests via form input.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission for quick reassign, updating request with new mechanic and status.
